name: School Pool
description: The school week for the children in your contacts: timetable, pickup times and who collects, holidays and special days, the kit each day needs, and the lunch menu you type in once a week.
author: Atli Bjorgvins

install.routes: src/routes (this repo's routes/ subtree is copied in verbatim by scripts/fetch-plugins.sh)
install.note: Run scripts/add-school-pool.sh from the twin repo root, add the four collections to PERSONAL in scripts/add-member-role.sh and re-run it, then register the manifest in src/lib/plugins/registry.ts and add 'school-pool' to src/lib/plugins/keys.ts.
